correctness.rationale: An exhaustive eigen-decomposition of the weighted Laplacian gives both source types of electrical potentials. Explicit sign classification yields all four exact absolute column sums. Their factored polynomial differences establish all unique, double and degenerate switching patterns, including the integer alignment condition m=2n+1. A standard-library exact rational checker reconstructed 3280 independent grounded-Laplacian columns in 120 graphs; finite checks supplement rather than replace the analytical argument.

value.rationale: The claim completely classifies a natural infinite two-part family over every positive conductance. Unlike an unmotivated isolated exact invariant, it exhibits an intrinsic dual-projection phase order reversal at m=2n+1 and genuine reentrance at low clique sizes. The exact edge-orbit transition locus can inform broader weighted graph projection and transport analyses; neither publication-scale breadth nor speculation about applications is used as a requirement.
